fieldNotes.location: Roster coords landed on the correct building; geocode movedMeters (21762) reflects a poor city-center geocoder start, not an error. Confirmed as 601 Innovative Way, Owensboro KY — large K-C diaper/personal-care manufacturing complex + on-site DC on a peninsula bounded by the Green River.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open campus-style entrance off Innovative Way at the public road — Street View (2019) shows a K-C monument sign and manicured-lawn drive with NO barrier at the road. An internal truck-yard checkpoint/pinch-point with fencing and a small structure is visible at ~37.8211,-87.3053 controlling access to the drop yard. Classed truckGate=true on the internal control point; low confidence on a hard barrier.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly resolvable guard booth at the public-road entrance or the internal checkpoint. A small structure plus parked vehicles sits beside the internal truck route but cannot be confirmed as a staffed booth at z20-21. Classed false / remoteGs true as best estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yard NW of the main building — 100+ trailers parked in long rows visible at z19-20. Honest estimate of 220 capacity is approximate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock face on the NW edge of the main warehouse/DC building with ~50+ trailers backed in; 55 is an approximate count from z20 imagery.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: large manufacturing building cluster, separate warehouse/DC, on-site wastewater treatment plant, steam/utility plant, and office front — multiple distinct building clusters.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal paved truck routes and large open apron offer room for an express/bypass lane.

citations.claim: K-C opened a new 120,000 sq ft on-site raw-materials warehouse at its Owensboro site in 2025; plant (~360 employees, operating since 1993) makes Kleenex facial tissue and Scott towels/bath tissue.
K-C own newsroom announces $2B US manufacturing expansion; active US footprint.

verification.rationale: K-C-owned plant operating since 1993, expanded with a new on-site warehouse opened 2025; no closure/sale evidence. (Label note: makes Kleenex/Scott tissue, not diaper/personal care.)
